layer_model: Layer A (Mac) runs the COMPLETE repository suite; Layer B (Docker) runs the PR-relevant PORTABLE subset. A test relevant to the PR that cannot run in Linux Docker is REQUIRED_MAC_ONLY with a mechanical host-dependency justification and a proven Mac result.

src/activation-path/launcher-failclose.s.host_dependency: macOS sysctl hw.model (hardware identity) + host process (claude) inspection

src/safety_check/canonical-identity.self.note: safety_check infra, not PR #182/#183 code; writable-tree need is not a legit Mac-only reason but the test is out of the PRs' Docker scope; executes green on Mac

src/supervisor/supervisor-deadline-integ.host_dependency: pgrep host-process inspection for residual-process verification
